question: Where is the nearest fast food restaurant while traveling toward Kindred Hospital Chicago Northlake, Northlake, IL from Hickory Grove Riverfront, Cary, IL?
sql: WITH origin_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Hickory Grove Riverfront%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Kindred Hospital Chicago Northlake%' AND amenity = 'hospital' LIMIT 1 ), travel_info AS ( SELECT op.geometry AS origin_geom, dp.geometry AS destination_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(op.geometry::geography, dp.geometry::geography)) AS travel_azimuth FROM origin_point op, destination_point dp WHERE op.geometry IS NOT NULL AND dp.geometry IS NOT NULL ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, travel_info ti WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ti.origin_geom IS NOT NULL AND ti.destination_geom IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ti.origin_geom::geography, 50000) -- Search within 50km radius from the origin AND ( -- Calculate the azimuth from the origin to the fast food restaurant -- and check if it's within +/- 45 degrees of the travel azimuth. -- LEAST handles the 0/360 degree wrap-around for angular difference. LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ti.origin_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography)) - ti.travel_azimuth), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ti.origin_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography)) - ti.travel_azimuth) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(ti.origin_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
